run_train_ibp_model: run the train.py script to train an interval bound propagation model on MNIST or CIFAR-10
build_layers_specification: build a layers specification tuple for a given model size like tiny, small, medium, or large
create_classification_losses: create classification losses with nominal, verified, and attack cross-entropy weights using ibp.create_classification_losses
test_model_metrics: test the trained model by computing nominal, verified, and attack accuracy metrics over test batches
summarize_show_metrics: summarize training metrics by printing nominal accuracy, verified accuracy, and attack accuracy at each step
